name: University of Manchester
typicalOffer: AAA-AAB, including two of Biology, Chemistry, Physics and Mathematics (the Core Sciences)
notes: 3-year BSc covering bacteriology, virology and antimicrobial resistance; Biology or Chemistry required; Wellcome Centre for Anti-Infectives Research on campus

name: University of Bristol
typicalOffer: AAB, including Chemistry and another core science/mathematics subject (Physics, Biology, Human Biology, Mathematics or Further Mathematics)
notes: 3-year BSc covering environmental microbiology, host-pathogen interactions and metagenomics; Biology required; strong infectious disease and public health research

name: University of Leeds
typicalOffer: AAB, including Biology or Chemistry and another science or science-related subject
notes: 3-year BSc; covers food microbiology, infection and immunity; Biology required; strong applied microbiology and food safety links to the food industry

name: University of Glasgow
typicalOffer: AAB, A-level Biology or Chemistry at grade A
notes: Scottish 4-year BSc (Hons); covers infection immunology and microbial pathogenesis; Biology required; Centre for Virus Research collaboration

name: University of Leicester
typicalOffer: BBB, including at least two relevant science subjects from Biology, Chemistry, Maths, Physics or Psychology; General Studies not accepted
notes: 3-year BSc covering clinical and environmental microbiology; Biology required; strong antibiotic resistance and parasitology research; optional placement year

name: Aberystwyth University
notes: 3-year BSc with strong environmental and agricultural microbiology; Biology required; links to IBERS (Institute of Biological, Environmental and Rural Sciences) and crop pathogen research
